shortDescription: Petrovietnam Refining and Petrochemical Corp HOSE:BSR, also known as BSR, said on Monday it is in talks to secure long-term ethanol supplies from China's SDIC Biotech.

children: , also known as BSR, said on Monday it is in talks to secure long-term ethanol supplies from China's SDIC Biotech.
Vietnam switched fully to ethanol-blended gasoline from June as part of its efforts to curb fossil fuel use.
BSR and SDIC have discussed options for ethanol cargoes of 5,000 to 5,500 cubic metres each, to be delivered by sea or land, it said.
The Southeast Asian country has to import 75,000 cubic metres of ethanol a month to meet demand, which is estimated at 100,000 cubic metres a month, BSR said.

Traders said Vietnam has been importing ethanol mainly from the United States. Ethanol has been among the items Vietnam had pledged to import from the U.S. to help narrow its trade surplus with its largest export market.
